note: The recorded end states of the IKEA references (ikea/tasks/roboarc-ikea-<name>-i00-privileged/solution/trajectory.npz): rcb_ikea.state_sha (sha256 of MuJoCo's integration state) after the last row ('end') and after the grader's 1.0 s hold of the last row ('settled'), as hex prefixes. Sources: the verifier's verdict.json of the Harbor oracle trials on the 1.0.0 images (16 hex digits), or ikea/scripts/ikea_mujoco/evidence.json (12 hex digits; only where its record names the shipped reference by its row count). Tasks without a record that matches the shipped reference are left out.
